title: Refactor procedural config loader into a Config dataclass
description: A messy Python config module uses global state and magic numbers. Refactor into a Config dataclass with validation. All tests must still pass after refactor.

injections.content:
[project]
name = "python-config-refactor"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["pytest>=8.0", "ruff>=0.4"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100

import pytest
from config import Config


def test_defaults():
    c = Config()
    assert c.host == "localhost"
    assert c.port == 8080
    assert c.workers == 4
    assert c.timeout == 30


def test_custom_values():
    c = Config(host="0.0.0.0", port=9000, workers=8, timeout=60)
    assert c.host == "0.0.0.0"
    assert c.port == 9000
    assert c.workers == 8
    assert c.timeout == 60


def test_invalid_port_low():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port"):
        Config(port=80)


def test_invalid_port_high():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="port"):
        Config(port=70000)


def test_invalid_workers_zero():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="workers"):
        Config(workers=0)


def test_invalid_workers_too_many():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="workers"):
        Config(workers=100)


def test_invalid_timeout():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="timeout"):
        Config(timeout=0)


def test_config_is_immutable_after_creation():
    c = Config(port=5000)
    assert c.port == 5000
    # dataclass frozen=True means this raises
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        c.port = 9999  # type: ignore

task_spec.prompt:
Refactor src/config.py: replace the procedural global-state approach with a Config dataclass.

Requirements:
  from dataclasses import dataclass

  @dataclass(frozen=True)
  class Config:
      host: str = "localhost"
      port: int = 8080
      workers: int = 4
      timeout: int = 30

      def __post_init__(self) -> None:
          — validate port in [1024, 65535], raise ValueError('port ...')
          — validate workers in [1, 64], raise ValueError('workers ...')
          — validate timeout >= 1, raise ValueError('timeout ...')

The existing procedural functions (init, get_host, etc.) can be removed.
All 8 tests in tests/test_config.py must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: Config is a frozen dataclass with 4 fields
Validation in __post_init__ with meaningful error messages
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ passes (8 tests)
uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
